s: Dine tzitzit bebet haqqebarot ubo h' seipim: muttar likkanes lebet haqqebarot vehu labush tzitzit, vehu shello yihyu tzitziyyotayv nigrarim al haqqebarim, kede shello yihyeh keloeg larash, kelomar shehammetim hem rashim upeturim min hammitzvot veen yekolim leqayyem otan veanu meqayyemin otan:

Bammeh debarim amurim shemmuttar likkanes betzitzit lebet haqqebarot? Betzitzit shemmetil bemalbush shellobesh letzorek atzmo, velo kede leqayyem mitzvat tzitzit, kegon sheyyesh lo od tallit acheret metzuyyetzet, kemo shehaya hamminhag bime chakme haggemara shehaya bekol bigdehem arba kenapot, shei epshar sheyyasir kol begadayv kesheyyelek lebet haqqebarot. Abal betallitot sheen mekavvenim bahem lemalbush ella kede leqayyem mitzvat tzitzit bilbad, kegon anu sheen anu mekavvenim bibgadim sheyyesh lahem arba kenapot ella leshem mitzva bilbad — asur likkanes bahem lebet haqqebarot apillu en hatztzitziyyot nigrarim al gabbe haqqebarim, mishshum loeg larash. Bammeh debarim amurim? Keshehatztzitziyyot megullim venirim — az yesh bahen mishshum loeg larash. Abal im hem mekussim veen nirim kelal — en kan loeg larash:

Yesh nohagin liqshor shette tzitziyyot shebbishne kenapot zeh im zeh keshenniknasim lebet haqqebarot, kede shettitbattel mitzvat tzitzit shealehem. Abal lo hoilu kelum betaqqanatam, deap-al-pi sheqqosherim zeh im zeh — lo nitbattel mitzvat tzitzit al yede zeh, shehare sopam lachazor ulehattir otam:
Hanniknas tok arba ammot shel met o tok arba ammot shel qeber o tok arba ammot shel bet haqqebarot — dino keniknas letok bet haqqebarot:

Bemaqom shennohagin lehasir hatztzitziyyot mittallit shel met babbayit shehu met sham qodem shemmotziin oto — asurim hakkattapim shennoseim oto lehitlabbesh betzitzit mishshum loeg larash, ella im ken tzitziyyotehem mekussim:
